prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (realistic human presenters vs. quick templated social ads, budget, platforms, languages, level of editing control). Below are top options by use case, with short pros/cons and price guidance to help you pick.

Quick picks by use case
- Best for ads with AI human presenters: Synthesia or HeyGen
  - Why: realistic multilingual avatars, script → finished video in minutes, good for product explainers and founder/CTA videos.
  - Pros: fast, scalable, consistent branding across many videos.
  - Cons: can look “template-y” if overused; cost per minute can be high.
  - Price: typically from $30–$50/month for basic plans; custom enterprise pricing for high volume.

- Best for templated social/video ads & lots of creatives fast: InVideo, Promo.com, Biteable, or Shakr
  - Why: large library of ad-focused templates, stock assets, and easy resizing for platform-specific formats.
  - Pros: very fast, optimized templates for Facebook/IG/TikTok, low learning curve.
  - Cons: less “AI person” realism; may need creative iteration for standout ads.
  - Price: $15–$50/month for premium features; Promo/Shakr have ad-focused plans.

- Best for repurposing long-form content into short ads: Pictory or Opus Clip
  - Why: AI chops long videos or text into short social clips with captions and highlight detection.
  - Pros: saves time turning webinars, podcasts, or webinars into multiple ads.
  - Cons: may need manual polishing for top performance.
  - Price: $15–$50/month.

- Best for advanced editing + AI tools (visual effects, generative tools): Runway, CapCut, VEED
  - Why: strong editing plus AI-assisted tools (background removal, text-to-video features).
  - Pros: more creative control and advanced features.
  - Cons: steeper learning curve; not as template-driven.
  - Price: free tiers and $10–$40+/month pro tiers.

- Best for high-converting, analytics-driven ad creation: Promo.com or any platform that integrates A/B testing and ad analytics (often via ad manager integrations)
  - Why: built specifically for ad creation and distribution, sometimes includes ad performance insights.
  - Cons: costs add up if you scale volume.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Platform(s): vertical video for TikTok/IG Reels? Square/landscape for Facebook/YouTube?
- Output type: AI presenter, animated text/video, or repurposed clips?
- Volume: one-offs vs. dozens/hundreds of creatives per month?
- Brand needs: strict brand kit, fonts, tone?
- Budget: low ($0–30/mo), mid ($30–100/mo), or enterprise?
- Languages: multilingual or single-language?
- Need for analytics/A-B testing/integration with ad platforms?

My recommendation
- If you need fast, scalable ad creatives across formats: try Promo.com or InVideo first.
- If you need realistic AI presenters: try Synthesia (or HeyGen) for a few test ads.
- If repurposing long videos into many short ads: try Pictory or Opus Clip.

Would you like a tailored shortlist? Tell me: what platform(s) you’re advertising on, your budget, and whether you want real human presenters, animated templates, or repurposed clips — I’ll recommend the top 2–3 best options and a suggested workflow.
